scope: Eight equal-size partial-day callbacks, not fourteen-day end-to-end complexity.
confirmed_costs: Two cumulative committed_rows calls per baseline callback.
Each previously committed active-day segment count and full projection checksum is recomputed.
Full active-day reconciliation and conflict checks invoke Spark jobs/shuffles.
Incoming rows are checked against a full independent daily source map every callback.
Globally sorted length-framed digest calculation includes driver iteration.

measurement_policy.timings: Inclusive function wall seconds; nested values overlap and are not additive.
measurement_policy.scans: Actual instrumented segment references plus Spark TaskEnd input/shuffle/spill counters.
measurement_policy.bytes: Spark reported filesystem bytes, not physical I/O or network.
unisolated: Individual driver digest serialization versus JVM iterator latency

segment_schedule.baseline: sum_i((i-1)+i)=n^2 for n incomplete callbacks; 64 at n=8
segment_schedule.reuse: sum_i(i-1)=n(n-1)/2; 28 at n=8; add full physical reread when completion is possible
segment_schedule.conclusion: Reduces duplicated callback work, not cumulative asymptotic order; completion checks are unchanged.

choice: Reuse verified merged DataFrame only within a callback; defer expensive full completion attempt until enough distinct logical rows exist, then reread physical committed history and apply exact oracle checks.
rejected_for_this_phase: Persistent trusted driver dictionary over all coordinates
Sidecar/index format migration without demonstrated need
performance_claim: 27.70% lower median local callback-total time on this partial pilot only.
